name: Single Sign-On
description:
Single Sign-On adds an OIDC login button to Jellyfin Web, provisions normal
Jellyfin users and device sessions, and lets existing users explicitly link
their Jellyfin account to an external identity. Playback, libraries, and all
other Jellyfin authorization continue to use Jellyfin's native user policy.
overview: OpenID Connect login, automatic user provisioning, and account linking for Jellyfin.
